title: VK-only Diagnostics: In libmodbus v3.1.6, sending a specific message to unit-test-server triggers a double-free bug
purpose: Explore an issue-related boundary while retaining built-in basic length consistency
expected_behavior: The server should parse one complete Diagnostics request and either return a normal diagnostic response or a protocol-level exception without desynchronizing the stream
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0006 equals unit identifier plus six PDU bytes
Diagnostics function code 08 with a two-byte subfunction and two-byte data field
issue_safety_notes: This is a structural analogue based on issue evidence and does not copy a historical crash payload. It is intended for controlled fuzzing; no crash outcome is asserted
